xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4424: Matt Pocock skills as a fork-sourced pack (eltmon/skills): toggle at global/project/issue level

plan.title: Matt Pocock skills as a fork-sourced pack (eltmon/skills): toggle at global/project/issue level
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-4352 (managed Claude launch check, covered by verify-managed-claude)

narratives.Problem: PAN-4334 shipped external skill packs (pinned git sources mounted per launch, toggled at global/project/issue level), but Overdeck's mattpocock defaults (KNOWN_PACKS url, CLI empty-list hint, dashboard add command, docs) still point at upstream mattpocock/skills, no pack is registered on this host, and the managed-launch check (#4352) never ran. The operator wants the pack sourced from the fork eltmon/skills, pinned to an approved commit, and verified at all three levels on managed Claude Code and Codex launches so they can evaluate it.
narratives.Proposal: Re-point the mattpocock defaults at https://github.com/eltmon/skills (KNOWN_PACKS url, CLI hint built from it, dashboard ADD_COMMAND literal, features/skills.mdx with a fork subsection and the real v1.2.3 preview). Register the pack on this host from the fork at tag v1.2.3 (commit 6acc160, the commit PAN-4334 audited). Verify global and project levels through the launch step (pan skills launch-settings) inside seconds-long windows, and run real managed Claude Code and Codex workers at issue level on PAN-4424. Record everything in .pan/drafts/PAN-4424-live-checkpoint.md and leave the pack registered but off at every level. The fork needs no changes: Overdeck already mounts only skill directories and marks setup-matt-pocock-skills opt-in by pack id.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No commits, branches, PRs, issues or comments on eltmon/skills or any mattpocock/* repo.
- No change to the PAN-4334 pack mechanism (resolver, mount, launch step, stores, API route).
- No retirement or replacement of the four vendored Matt Pocock skills (grilling, codebase-design, domain-modeling, improve-codebase-architecture).
- No settings-based alternative to --plugin-dir; a consent dialog is reported via pan tell, not fixed in this issue.
- No Deft (eltmon/directive) or SageOx (eltmon/ox) work.
- No pack left enabled at any level after verification.
- No remote (Fly) or non-Claude/Codex harness support.
- No edits to docs/USAGE.md, reference/template-conversations.mdx or changelog.mdx.

autoDecisions.summary: Pin the fork at tag v1.2.3 (commit 6acc160e4e0cd062dbbbd7a1b26ae92855edf07e).
autoDecisions.rationale: Latest release tag, present on the fork, and the exact commit PAN-4334 audited (25 skills, 1 opt-in, 2 unapplied template scripts). Fork main is an untagged v1.3 merge; the operator can re-pin with pan skills pack update.

autoDecisions.summary: Make no changes in the eltmon/skills fork.
autoDecisions.rationale: Overdeck already mounts only skill directories and already treats setup-matt-pocock-skills as opt-in by pack id (KNOWN_PACKS), so the fork stays identical to upstream with nothing to rebase or propose.

autoDecisions.summary: Verify global and project levels through pan skills launch-settings, and run real managed launches only at issue level on PAN-4424.
autoDecisions.rationale: Global and project toggles apply to every launch on the host or project while on; the launch step is the literal command every managed launcher runs, so seconds-long windows prove the level logic without exposing other agents, while issue level confines the managed launches to this issue.

autoDecisions.summary: End state: pack registered, off at every level, mounts garbage-collected.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the operator tests the result; docs carry the enable commands.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the four vendored Matt Pocock skills; defer the replace-with-pack decision.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to decide it separately; vendored skills are default-on while the pack is default-off, so retiring them changes every user's defaults before the operator has evaluated the pack.
configuration/skills.mdx does not exist; features/skills.mdx holds the Skill packs section the issue refers to as the packs page.

autoDecisions.summary: Treat #4352 as covered by verify-managed-claude: reference it in the PR body and comment the checkpoint path on it, leave closing to the operator.
autoDecisions.rationale: Its five steps are exactly that item; commenting on an eltmon/overdeck issue is allowed.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. The launch step resolves the project from --cwd (resolveProjectKeyForCwdAsync in src/lib/skill-overrides/launch.ts), and this workspace lies under project panopticon-cli (path /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck). Use scratch dirs outside the repo; WS = this workspace path. For each level (global: pan skills set --pack mattpocock on; project: ... on --project panopticon-cli; issue: ... on --issue PAN-4424): run pan skills launch-settings --harness claude-code --cwd "$WS" [--issue PAN-4424 for issue level] --plugin-link <scratch>/<level>-link, then find -L <link> -name SKILL.md | wc -l (expect 24) and find -L <link> -path '*setup-matt-pocock-skills*' (expect nothing); run pan skills launch-settings --harness codex --cwd "$WS" [--issue PAN-4424] --codex-home <scratch>/<level>-ch and grep -A1 'plugins."mattpocock@overdeck-packs"' <ch>/config.toml (expect enabled = true). Revert global with 'off' and project with 'inherit --project panopticon-cli' immediately after their block; keep issue on. Narrowing check: global on + issue off, launch step with --issue PAN-4424 leaves the link absent; then global off and issue on again. Record every block verbatim under '## Levels (launch step)'. Checkpoint: if an issue-level set fails with a rebase/lock message, re-run with OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP=1; if it still fails, stop and report via pan tell flywheel-orchestrator.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6 (covers #4352). Precondition from verify-levels: issue pack on for PAN-4424, global off, project inherit. Run pan worker run --issue PAN-4424 --harness claude-code --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --read-only --detach --name pack-probe-claude --prompt "List every available skill whose name contains 'grilling' or 'setup-matt-pocock', exactly as named in your skill list, one per line. Do not invoke any skill. Then record that list as your worker report with pan worker report." It prints the worker id. Then pan worker wait <worker-id> --timeout 600 (expect exit 0) and record the report. While the worker is still alive, find its pane with herdr pane list and capture it with herdr pane read <pane-id>; record that output. Then stop the worker: pan kill <worker-id>; if that refuses a worker id or leaves the pane, herdr pane close <pane-id>. Record everything under '## Managed Claude Code launch'. Checkpoint: if pan worker wait exits 2 or 3 or the pane shows a plugin consent/trust dialog, record the pane text, run pan tell flywheel-orchestrator describing it (needs PAN-4334 PRD section 4.7 settings-based route), and do not implement that route here.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7. Run pan worker run --issue PAN-4424 --harness codex --model gpt-5.6-luna --read-only --detach --name pack-probe-codex --prompt <same prompt as verify-managed-claude>, then pan worker wait <worker-id> --timeout 600 (expect exit 0), capture its pane with herdr pane read, and stop it the same way as verify-managed-claude. gpt-5.6-luna is the host's workhorses.cheap model (~/.overdeck/config.yaml). If it does not route to Codex here, use any OpenAI model the host config routes to Codex and record which. Record the report and grep -A1 'plugins."mattpocock@overdeck-packs"' ~/.overdeck/agents/<worker-id>/codex-home-v2/config.toml under '## Managed Codex launch'. Same dialog checkpoint as verify-managed-claude. Then comment on eltmon/overdeck issue #4352 (gh issue comment 4352 --repo eltmon/overdeck) with the checkpoint doc path; never comment on any mattpocock/* repo.
